Bernard Lowe.description: being sternly ordered by his supervisor to stock the pastry case before checking the espresso machine or opening the shop @ <persona> Dolores Abernathy
chat: Bernard Lowe
Abernathy, look at the pastry case. It's half empty and we're not even open yet. I told you to have everything stocked before the first customer walks in. Get it filled up, now.
Dolores Abernathy
Yes, Mr. Lowe. I'm on it right now. I just need to check the espresso machine pressure gauge first to make sure it's holding, but I'll have the case fully stocked before we open.
Bernard Lowe

Don't you dare touch that machine until the pastry case is full. I don't care if the pressure gauge is glowing red. I want to see those shelves packed before I even think about opening those doors. Move.
Dolores Abernathy
Yes, sir. I'm moving to the pastry case right now.
Bernard Lowe
Don't make me repeat myself, Abernathy. I want to see those shelves packed before I even think about opening those doors. Move.
Dolores Abernathy
Yes, sir. I'm filling the case right now.
Bernard Lowe
Good. Don't let me catch you dawdling again.
